name: Shaista Khan
seoTitle: Shaista Khan: Mughal Subahdar and the Chittagong Campaign
seoDescription: Learn how Shaista Khan's Bengal administration and 1666 Chittagong campaign strengthened Mughal control on the southeastern frontier.
role: Mughal subahdar linked to the Chittagong campaign
contribution: As Bengal's subahdar, he directed the campaign that ended Arakanese control over Chittagong in 1666.
context: His administration combined naval operations and frontier governance in southeastern Bengal.
impact: His tenure strengthened Mughal maritime-security control in the Bay-facing frontier.
highlight: Shaista Khan's campaign integrated Chittagong into Mughal Bengal.
